knowledge_gaps: The residual is not fully reproducible: window size, decay formula and units, gate initialization, normalization parameters, and empty-prefix behavior are unspecified. Pooling must include only observed inputs through position t, never the next-item target.

A near-zero gate does not guarantee baseline equivalence: the added outer LayerNorm can change SASRec features even when the residual contribution vanishes. Normalization therefore confounds the proposed architectural ablation.

The evaluation plan lacks explicit controls separating recency weighting from unordered item pooling, last-item emphasis, and extra normalization. A dataset-level scalar gate also cannot establish detection of individual intent shifts, compatibility, or satisfied demand.

Trial counts, checkpoint selection, diagnostic frequency, and GPU-time allocation are unspecified. Adaptive selection on 800 validation users can overfit; paired confidence intervals do not correct that selection bias.

Originality 4/10 is reasonable, but potential 7/10 and difficulty 3/10 are provisional. No measured gains or runtime estimates support them, and predictor parity, causal masking, and diagnostic integration add implementation work.
